# About Northwind Labs

## Our story

Northwind Labs was founded in 2016 by three engineers working out of a garage in Portland. The company shipped its first product, a sensor kit for greenhouses, in 2018. In 2020 it raised a Series A of $12 million, and in 2022 it opened a second office in Berlin. By 2024 Northwind sensors were running in more than 4,000 greenhouses across Europe and North America.

## What we believe

We think good tools should be quiet, durable and easy to repair. Everything we build is designed to last a decade in a humid, dusty greenhouse.
